title: create_procedural_texture specification
description: Goal-level procedural Texture2D generation for VFX material slots. CPU pixel fill via FImageUtils::CreateTexture2D [VERIFIED: ImageUtils.h:268] — no Epic MaterialTools equivalent. Also invoked internally from create_vfx_material specification.textures.generate slots. Owned by WS-08.

generate.description: Procedural generator kind. flow_map uses TC_VectorDisplacementmap; noise/voronoi use TC_Grayscale. flipbook_atlas packs procedural per-frame cells into a grid atlas (requires flipbook.columns/rows).

seed.description: Deterministic seed. When omitted, defaults to CRC32 of target.asset_path.

flipbook.description: Required when generate is flipbook_atlas. Grid layout for future atlas assembly.

frame_count.description: Active frames; defaults to columns * rows when omitted.
